body.value: How many different products Contoso sold at least one of in calendar year 2023: 2,485. Each product counts once however often it sold and however many units went out, and a product here is one SKU — so the same item in a second colour counts as a second product, which is what this bundle means by the word. The year is fixed by the date the order was placed, over the full twelve months 1 January to 31 December 2023, read across 46,077 sale lines. NOT INCLUDED: the 32 of the catalogue's 2,517 products that went the whole year without a single sale; anything ordered outside 2023; and no deduction for cancelled orders or returned goods, because this bundle records no order status by which to deduct them. Both channels are in — the physical shops and the web shop — and all five transaction currencies.

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    order_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND order_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS lines_ordered_2023,
  COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) FILTER(WHERE
    order_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND order_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS products_ordered_2023,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    delivery_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND delivery_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS lines_delivered_2023,
  COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) FILTER(WHERE
    delivery_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND delivery_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS products_delivered_2023,
  MIN(order_date) FILTER(WHERE
    order_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND order_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS first_order_in_2023,
  MAX(order_date) FILTER(WHERE
    order_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND order_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS last_order_in_2023
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_key) AS products_as_sku,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_code) AS distinct_product_codes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_name) AS distinct_product_names,

  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
